class.name: LRTDetailVolume3D
class.brief_description: A subordinate fine LRT grid within a calculation group.
class.description: Belongs to the nearest LRTGI or LRTVolume3D ancestor. Details cannot be nested, must remain fixed relative to their parent, must be fully contained, and require finer world-space probe spacing. Bake through the parent group. Geometry and A/L states are independent; only the parent supplies boundary lighting. Priority and intensity belong to the parent group.
